The **Circuit Breaker** is a pistol in *Fallout 76*, introduced in *Season 15: The Big Score*.

A modified 10mm Pistol that comes with the Anti-Armor (50% Armor Penetration) and Swift (15% Reload Speed) legendary modifications. It also has a build-in perk, which creates an energy blast that deals damage and stuns enemies within 50 foot if the last round of a magazine hits its target. After the stun expires, enemies receive stun immunity for 10 seconds.

The weapon could originally be unlocked for crafting during Season 15: *The Big Score*.
